title: MND budget debate: housing, lift access, ageing estates and pest birds
what_it_is: A Committee of Supply debate on Head T of the Estimates for the Ministry of National Development, opened by Mr Henry Kwek moving a $100 reduction and ending with him seeking leave to withdraw the amendment.
why_it_matters: The debate covers HDB affordability, public rental, lift access, ageing estates, executive condominiums and pest birds. The transcript records that public rental has had no income ceiling since 2023, that HDB will look to implement lift access for 40 identified blocks within the next three years, and that a pigeon netting trial for 35 units will run from March to next March. Other proposals remain under review or without stated timelines.

key_points.point: Mr Henry Kwek moved that the total sum allocated for Head T of the Estimates be reduced by $100.
key_points.speaker: Mr Kwek Hian Chuan Henry (Kebun Baru)
key_points.quote: That the total sum to be allocated for Head T of the Estimates be reduced by $100.

key_points.point: Mr Henry Kwek called for a timely policy move to lower the BTO flat eligibility age to 33 for singles.
key_points.speaker: Mr Kwek Hian Chuan Henry (Kebun Baru)
key_points.quote: I look forward to a timely policy move to lower the BTO flat eligibility age to, hopefully, 33 for singles.

key_points.point: Mr Henry Kwek asked MND to consider a targeted programme for sandwiched-class families facing loan ineligibility.
key_points.speaker: Mr Kwek Hian Chuan Henry (Kebun Baru)
key_points.quote: I hope that MND can consider creating a targeted programme, like they did for fresh starts

key_points.point: Mr Henry Kwek asked MND to conduct a timely review of the income ceiling.
key_points.speaker: Mr Kwek Hian Chuan Henry (Kebun Baru)
key_points.quote: Can MND conduct a timely review?

key_points.point: Mr Henry Kwek asked where land for housing will be found.
key_points.speaker: Mr Kwek Hian Chuan Henry (Kebun Baru)
key_points.quote: Where are we going to find the land?

key_points.point: Mr Henry Kwek suggested HDB offer residents above 50 a same room-type replacement flat with a shorter lease under VERS.
key_points.speaker: Mr Kwek Hian Chuan Henry (Kebun Baru)
key_points.quote: HDB should offer residents, especially those above 50, the option of a same room-type replacement flat with perhaps a shorter lease, so they do not need to find cash to top-up for a new flat.

key_points.point: Mr Pritam Singh asked whether HDB would let first-timer couples above the income ceiling buy a BTO flat with additional requirements.
key_points.speaker: Mr Pritam Singh (Aljunied)
key_points.quote: would HDB consider allowing a first-timer couple who exceed the income eligibility threshold to, nonetheless, be given the option of purchasing a BTO flat?

key_points.point: Mr Pritam Singh asked how many appeals HDB received from first-time applicants blocked by the income ceiling each year from 2020 to 2025.
key_points.speaker: Mr Pritam Singh (Aljunied)
key_points.quote: can the Minister also share how many appeals it has received from first-time applicants who sought to purchase a BTO flat but could not do so because of the income eligibility ceiling for each year from 2020 to 2025?

key_points.point: Mr Pritam Singh asked whether HDB would include water seepage from block facades in the Facade Repairs Co-payment Scheme.
key_points.speaker: Mr Pritam Singh (Aljunied)
key_points.quote: Would HDB reach out to assist Town Councils through the Facade Repairs Co-payment Scheme to allow for the inclusion of claims to be made for water seepage cases that originate from the block facade?

key_points.point: Mr Azhar Othman proposed an independent regulatory statutory board under MND to monitor rental rates.
key_points.speaker: Mr Azhar Othman (Nominated Member)
key_points.quote: I propose that a council, like the Public Transport Council, an independent regulatory Statutory Board and in this case, under MND, be established to monitor rental rates in the market.

key_points.point: Mr Louis Chua called for a large-scale tender of multiple HDB sites for affordable meals.
key_points.speaker: Mr Chua Kheng Wee Louis (Sengkang)
key_points.quote: I hope the HDB can consider a large-scale tender of multiple sites across HDB towns to ensure that affordable and accessible meals are available to all residents across Singapore

key_points.point: Mr Louis Chua urged MND to rethink the EC model and bring EC prices back toward their original intentions.
key_points.speaker: Mr Chua Kheng Wee Louis (Sengkang)
key_points.quote: I urge the MND to seriously re-think the current EC model and to consider upstream policies to bring the price of ECs into a range that will suit their original intentions.

key_points.point: Ms Sylvia Lim raised for review the imposition of the MOP on listed occupiers who are not owners.
key_points.speaker: Ms Sylvia Lim (Aljunied)
key_points.quote: One area that I wish to raise for review is the imposition of the MOP on non-owners that is on the listed occupiers of a flat.

key_points.point: Mr Cai Yinzhou asked whether income ceilings should be recalibrated to reflect current wages.
key_points.speaker: Mr Cai Yinzhou (Bishan-Toa Payoh)
key_points.quote: Is it time to recalibrate income ceilings to reflect today's wage realities?

key_points.point: Mr Fadli Fawzi proposed a shared equity pilot programme to help families achieve home ownership sooner.
key_points.speaker: Mr Fadli Fawzi (Aljunied)
key_points.quote: My second proposal is a shared equity pilot programme to help families achieve home ownership sooner.

key_points.point: Mr Fadli Fawzi asked for targeted cash support for seniors in older, smaller flats who struggle to pay for EASE or HIP repairs.
key_points.speaker: Mr Fadli Fawzi (Aljunied)
key_points.quote: I would like to ask the Government to consider providing targeted cash support for any seniors living in older, smaller flats who may face difficulties paying for repairs under EASE or HIP.

key_points.point: Mr Liang Eng Hwa asked for the projected supply of Community Care Apartments over the next five years.
key_points.speaker: Mr Liang Eng Hwa (Bukit Panjang)
key_points.quote: what is the projected supply of Community Care Apartments over the next five years?

key_points.point: Mr Liang Eng Hwa asked MND to review the baseline quantum of the S&CC Operating Grant.
key_points.speaker: Mr Liang Eng Hwa (Bukit Panjang)
key_points.quote: will MND consider reviewing the baseline quantum of S&CC Operating Grant to reflect new cost realities?

key_points.point: Mr Xie Yao Quan urged MND to make the baseline VERS compensation package one where affected homeowners need not top up cash for a replacement flat.
key_points.speaker: Mr Xie Yao Quan (Jurong Central)
key_points.quote: I urge the Ministry to consider making the baseline VERS deal, the baseline VERS compensation package, one in which an affected homeowner will not need to top up cash for a new replacement flat.

key_points.point: Mr Dennis Tan called on MND to consolidate its assessment framework into two mandatory commitments.
key_points.speaker: Mr Dennis Tan Lip Fong (Hougang)
key_points.quote: I call on MND to consolidate its assessment framework into two mandatory commitments.

key_points.point: Mr Dennis Tan asked for a clear timeline for LUP for the 40 blocks.
key_points.speaker: Mr Dennis Tan Lip Fong (Hougang)
key_points.quote: please define a clear timeline for LUP for the 40 blocks.

key_points.point: Mr Ang Wei Neng suggested extending the Lift Access Housing Grant to households with at least one occupier aged 70 and above.
key_points.speaker: Mr Ang Wei Neng (West Coast-Jurong West)
key_points.quote: We hope HDB can consider extending the Lift Access Housing Grant to households where at least one occupier is aged 70 and above

key_points.point: Mr Ang Wei Neng proposed stronger funding, manpower and a national strategy for pest bird management.
key_points.speaker: Mr Ang Wei Neng (West Coast-Jurong West)
key_points.quote: I propose that MND strengthen dedicated funding and manpower for pest bird management and develop a clear national strategy with measurable outcomes

key_points.point: Mr Pritam Singh asked about protocols for culling or shooting crows.
key_points.speaker: Mr Pritam Singh (Aljunied)
key_points.quote: Can the Ministry share its protocols with regard to culling, or specifically shooting, as a means of reducing the crow population in Singapore?

key_points.point: Mr Abdul Muhaimin Abdul Malik raised concern about the pace of the pigeon management roll-out.
key_points.speaker: Mr Abdul Muhaimin Abdul Malik (Sengkang)
key_points.quote: I am concerned about the pace of the roll-out.

key_points.point: Mr Chee Hong Tat said the EC review is ongoing and no specific timeline can be given.
key_points.speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
key_points.quote: The EC review is ongoing. So, I cannot give you a specific timeline.

key_points.point: Mr Chee Hong Tat said the supply pipeline will not be limited to 55,000 units.
key_points.speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
key_points.quote: we are not going to keep ourselves limited to the 55,000

key_points.point: Mr Chee Hong Tat said the 15-month wait-out period will persist for now while the resale market is monitored.
key_points.speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
key_points.quote: I think we should persist with this a little while more, monitor the data and at an appropriate time when we are ready, let us make a move.

key_points.point: Dr Syed Harun Alhabsyi said there is no income ceiling for public rental since 2023.
key_points.speaker: Dr Syed Harun Alhabsyi
key_points.quote: there is no income ceiling for public rental since 2023.

key_points.point: Dr Syed Harun Alhabsyi said HDB will look to implement lift access for the 40 identified blocks within the next three years.
key_points.speaker: Dr Syed Harun Alhabsyi
key_points.quote: We will be looking to implement the progress for the 40 blocks identified within the next three years.

key_points.point: Mr Alvin Tan said the pigeon netting trial for 35 units starts in March and ends next March.
key_points.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
key_points.quote: the trial for the 35 units is ongoing. We start in March. We will end next March.

key_points.point: Mr Alvin Tan said the second Marine Park is intended to safeguard ecologically significant habitats and provide spaces for recreation, research, outreach and education.
key_points.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
key_points.quote: the intent is to safeguard the ecologically significant habitats around the area

key_points.point: Mr Henry Kwek sought leave to withdraw his amendment.
key_points.speaker: Mr Kwek Hian Chuan Henry (Kebun Baru)
key_points.quote: I seek leave to withdraw my amendments.

what_happens_next: Mr Henry Kwek sought leave to withdraw his amendment; the transcript ends at that point.
